title: A Bunch Of Game-Breaking Bugs Just Got Fixed In Pokemon Pokopia
description: You might have been facing progression issues in Pokopia recently that have prevented you from enjoying the game to its full potential. Now, a new Pokopia update has rolled out that fixes those issues, along with some other lesser-known problems that you may not have even noticed. There are several in-game tasks that were blocked by a set of circumstances you may not even have figured out. While in the Bleak Beach--one of the game's later areas--attempting to complete the Find the Pokemon Center! quest for Professor Tangrowth had some players stumped. It turns out that if the cracked blocks on the bridge were broken before the Professor had the chance to cross it, the request would become difficult to progress. Similarly, a "specific sequence of actions" would also prevent the bridge-repair quest from triggering, meaning you couldn't continue the main story. Problems occurred in the early game too. In the Withered Wasteland, Squirtle had a tendency to accidentally climb a nearby tree, making him impossible to talk to, and hindering progress there. In Rocky Ridges, the Clear Off the Path! quest could have progression blocked "under certain conditions" and occasionally the story-essential CD-playing Rotom wouldn't appear for you to meet. If you're further through Pokopia's main story, you'll know that's pretty much a game-breaking problem. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: How The Dark Knight Returns Defined Modern Batman And The Best Ways To Experience It Today
description: The Dark Knight Returns graphic novels and Blu-rays Celebrate 40 years of the landmark Batman series See at Amazon This year marks the 40th anniversary of The Dark Knight Returns, a landmark storyline that redefined Batman for the modern age. written and illustrated by the team of Frank Miller, Klaus Janson, and Lynn Varley, the four-issue mini-series is still a must-read adventure that follows an older Batman as he comes out of retirement to face off against several of his iconic rogues and mutant gangs that have emerged on the streets of Gotham. If you've never read it or you're looking to rediscover the gritty storyline, there are plenty of options available, from reprints of the mini-series to animated adaptations. Here's a closer look at what you can pick up currently. The Dark Knight Returns graphic novels The celebrated saga that is credited for transforming Batman's image from campy Caped Crusader back to a hard-boiled vigilante, this has been in print as a collected-edition graphic novel for many years now. The 30th Anniversary Edition paperback is the cheapest option at $12.82 (was $30), and a DC Compact Comics Edition will be released on April 7 and is priced at $10. This is part of DC's line of new pocket-friendly graphic novels, so if you're looking for some affordable reading material for your morning commute, it's a good option. If you feel like spoiling yourself, you can also pick up The Dark Knight Returns Slipcase Set for $38.21 (was $50). Inside, you'll find all four volumes of The Dark Knight Returns in a hardcover format, housed inside a deluxe slipcase cover that features Frank Miller's iconic artwork. An Absolute Edition of The Dark Knight Returns that includes the sequel series The Dark Knight Strikes Again is also available, and it includes additional commentary on the stories. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Legacy Of Kain Fans Can Now Preorder A Stunning Map Of Nosgoth
description: The Legacy of Kain series is steadily making a comeback after decades of hibernation. We've seen ports and remasters of classic games in the series like Soul Reaver and Legacy of Kain: Defiance, as well as a new spin-off game, Legacy of Kain: Ascendance, launching later this month. These releases have been bolstered by graphic novels and other content that flesh out the world-building of the cult-classic vampire fantasy series, including an all-new Legacy of Kain: Map of Nosgoth, coming soon from graphic novel publisher Dark Horse. Illustrated by renowned artist Francesca Baerald, the Nosgoth map pulls landmarks, regions, and fan-favorite characters from across the entire Legacy of Kain series to create a unique work of cartographic art. Priced at $50, it's now available to preorder exclusively through the Dark Horse Direct Store ahead of its release, which is tentatively planned for late Spring 2025. Legacy of Kain: Map of Nosgoth Fine Art Print $50 | Releases Q2 2026 Gallery After centuries of conflict, the map reflects the state of Nosgoth and the brutal wars it has endured, with iconic locations like the horrific gardens at Dark Eden to the nine Pillars of Nosgoth featured on it. Each corner of the map is also anchored by iconic heroes and adversaries, such as Raziel (top right), Kain, Janos Audron, Vorador (top left), Moebius (bottom right), Mortanius (bottom left), and Ariel (bottom center). As an added touch, the Elder God extends his arms and watchful eyes along the print's borders. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: New Counter-Strike 2 Update Completely Changes How You Manage Ammo
description: Counter-Strike is getting one of its biggest gameplay shakeups in years, with a change to ammo management that will force players to be more mindful about how and when they reload. From today, reloading in Counter-Strike 2 will dump the unused ammo from that magazine, replacing it with a fresh magazine from your limited reserves. In the update announcement, Valve says that the change is intended to make players think before they reload. "When you reload in CS2, the leftover ammo in your magazine is dumped back into an essentially endless reserve supply," the blog explains. "And so the decision to reload has never offered significant trade-offs--in a safe position with enough time, you might reload after firing a single bullet, or half a mag, or after firing down to empty, and the rest of the round would be unaffected." Now, instead of a reload function that simply tops off your existing supply with a couple of bullets, reloading will mean discarding whatever part of a magazine has gone unused. The way ammo is displayed on screen has also been updated to reflect this change--the fill level of the current magazine will be displayed under the ammo count, while reserve ammo will be measured in mags, shells, or bullets depending on the weapon. Continue Reading at GameSpot

A Mod To Turn Baldur's Gate 3 Into Baldur's Gate 1 Is In The Works, Demo Out Now
description: A group of Baldur's Gate 3 modders are working on a massive mod for the game that effectively turns Baldur's Gate 3 into the game that started it all: 1998's Baldur's Gate. The team of modders--who collectively go by the name Deathbringer's Reign--are led by project organizer 786r786, who previously created a Baldur's Gate 3 mod that recreates Candlekeep, the opening location from the original Baldur's Gate. Players went wild for the Candlekeep mod, which led to more interest in its creator, and eventually player requests for a full Baldur's Gate mod. "I received a lot of requests from fans of the original games to turn it into a full campaign, along with offers from some incredibly talented modders who volunteered to help," 786r786 explained (via Rock Paper Shotgun). "Making an isolated custom campaign is actually a bit easier than making an extension to the base game; you don't have to account for the incredibly vast amount of scenarios present in vanilla BG3, and you have full control over the player's environment."
